headline: Press Gazette reports that Quartz's website is now filled mostly by one AI-assisted byline that published at least 52 articles in a single day.
score_reason: Kept at 5: a concrete example of a news brand leaning on AI, but the AI-detection results come from the reporting outlet's own tool and Quartz has not replied.
importance_line: Readers of Quartz and journalists are affected as a former newsroom of over 200 people now relies on AI-assisted copy, but the AI-written finding rests on Press Gazette's own detector and Quartz has not commented.
summary: Press Gazette reports that nearly all of the daily website reporting at business news site Quartz is credited to one byline, Cris Tolomia, who wrote at least 52 articles on 8 Oct 2026, and that Press Gazette's own AI detector rated sampled articles as largely AI-generated. Quartz's site says AI is central to how it reports, with human oversight, and neither Quartz nor its owner Redbrick has replied to Press Gazette's questions.
notes: Full Press Gazette text read. AI-detector results are from Press Gazette's own MadeByHumans tool.
